comment: Disk tree for the DYNAMIC-USERLAND GATE (run.sh dynamic).
Identical to manifest.json except /sbin/launchd is the static
exec-runner work/init_exec, which execve()s the dylib-linked /bin/echo.
That is the whole point: manifest.json's PID 1 execs nothing, so the
standard boot cannot observe dyld, the libSystem closure or a dylib
main(). If the two trees ever diverge beyond the launchd payload, that
is a bug in this file, not a feature.
The 'init_exec' marker makes mkimage.py select work/init_exec.
